notes.title: Tri Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Odyssey is out now!
notes.content:
A decade has passed since the events of Twin Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Adventure. After successfully unraveling the mystery behind NASA’s disappearing generation ships, heroic pilots Colin and Chris have entered quiet lives of retirement. But the copious data they brought back from their remarkable journey has been fully studied, and shadowy government figures are keen on exploiting new discoveries to achieve potentially sinister ends. Can a third hero -- the brave government liaison Dustin -- convince the boys to put a stop to the renewed madness? If Twin Breaker was a brick breaker about space, Tri Breaker is a brick breaker on steroids, and this go-around, it’s all about time. Explore 40 brand new stages spread across four periods of galactic history, and obliterate the brick-breaking formula with new action-oriented gameplay quirks and formulas that you’ve never seen before in the genre. With boss fights, tons of story and dialogue, a retro-fueled soundtrack, and much more, Tri Breaker: A Sacred Symbols Odyssey is inspired by the one of the most popular video game podcasts on Earth, Sacred Symbols, is written by long-time gaming personality Colin Moriarty, and is the sixth title from Lillymo Games.

Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2888530/Tri_Breaker_A_Sacred_Symbols_Odyssey/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2888530/Tri_Breaker_A_Sacred_Symbols_Odyssey/[/url]

notes.title: 16:10 Support Added
notes.content:
With this latest update we have added support for 16:10 aspect ratio.
You can find the option to switch between 16:9 and 16:10 within the options menu.
If you are playing on Steam Deck, the game will auto-detect that and swap to 16:10 for you.

notes.title: Input Detection Update
notes.content:
With this latest update controller type is now auto-detected and Input GUI is swapped to the appropriate controller type.
Supports DualShock 4, DualSense, Xbox One controller, Xbox Series X/S controller, Xbox 360 controller, Switch Pro controller, Steam Deck and more.

notes.title: Steam Deck Resolution Fix
notes.content: After testing Super Perils of Baking on the Steam Deck, we found that some of the menus were not displaying properly there. This update will address those menus so that everything looks correct across the board on the Steam Deck.

notes.title: 01.016 Update and 64 bit / 32 bit branches
notes.content:
With this latest update for the Steam version of Super Perils of Baking (01.016) we have shifted to a 64 bit requirement. This is due to our engine GameMaker making this change to their export capabilities. If you want to play the game in 32 bit you can still do so by accessing the 32 bit branch. You can do this by right clicking the game within Steam, selecting properties, then the Betas tab. The 32 bit branch will be listed in a drop down menu that you can select there. No password is required.

Live today in update 01.016 are a number of small bug fixes, as well as the implementation of the Steam/Community screenshot function. We look forward to seeing the screenshots you guys will share with the community going forward.
